title: mail: Email object type (Article→Email mapping)
description:
Define Email struct in crates/mail/src/email/types.rs: id=CID.to_string(), blobId=CID.to_string(), mailboxIds={mailbox_id: true}, keywords (empty until user-flags wired), receivedAt (HLC timestamp → RFC 3339), size (byte count from overview), from (Vec<EmailAddress>), subject, messageId, inReplyTo, references, preview (first 256 chars of body). Use HeaderMapNode fields from ArticleRootNode when available; fall back to overview record fields.

Why: the Email object type is the schema that JMAP clients parse; getting it right now avoids breaking clients later.

Acceptance: given an ArticleRootNode, Email::from_root_node() produces a valid JMAP Email object with all required fields present.
